KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

3. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

5. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Anga.

6. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. nene

7. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.

8. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Anga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

8. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
